weapon_10mm_pistol: Small, dependable, reasonably powerful, and available, the 10mm pistol has been a staple widely since the bombs first fell.
weapon_44_pistol: The .44 pistol is a double-action revolver, chambered to use the .44 Magnum cartridge. It's a powerful gun, though not as customizable as other handguns. Due to their simple, rugged design, they're prized by their owners, but not so uncommon as to be truly rare.
weapon_flare_gun: A Flare gun is a break-action single-shot device not really designed to inflict damage. Rather, it shoots signal flares which are used by many factions to signal for assistance by firing them high into the air.
weapon_assault_rifle: This gas-operated rifle is a common sight across the wasteland, and well-liked because of the low recoil and reasonable accuracy, and the ease of modifications. Most versions found are only capable of semi-automatic fire, but the weapon is easily modified for automatic fire.
weapon_combat_rifle: A pre-War weapon found across the wastelands and used in large numbers by various aggressive factions. Combat Rifles are a rugged and adaptable design, able to be modified to fill a variety of different battlefield roles.
weapon_combat_shotgun: Combat shotguns are shotguns intended for an offensive role, typically by a military force; they're ideal for close-range fighting in tunnels, within buildings, or through the ruined streets of old cities.
weapon_gauss_rifle: The gauss rifle uses magnetic induction to propel a projectile at incredible, devastating speeds. Each shot can be "charged" for maximum damage by holding the trigger for a moment before releasing to fire.
weapon_gauss_pistol: A handheld alternative to a full-sized gauss rifle. Despite its small size, it maintains formidable stopping power over considerable distances, and in the hands of a skilled user, it can bring down even the most durable foes.
weapon_hunting_rifle: A bolt-action rifle commonly found in the hands of super mutants and raiders. The simple design made them common amongst hunters and survivalists before the Great War, and they're endlessly customizable. It seems fanciful to suggest that the simple short-barrelled slug-thrower carried by a super mutant could be turned into a precision sniper's rifle, yet that describes the hunting rifle perfectly.
weapon_submachine_gun: These submachine guns were an old design, even before the War, and while they're hideously inaccurate, their rate-of-fire means you don't need to be accurate.
weapon_double_barrel_shotgun: Before the Great War, double-barrel shotguns were mainly used for hunting and home defense, and this has changed little. They are break-action and come in an either a side-by-side or over-and-under barrel configuration. Simple to make and maintain, these shotguns are seen frequently in the Commonwealth and the rest of the wasteland.
weapon_pipe_bolt_action:
A makeshift weapon usually seen in the hands of those who cannot make, buy, or scavenge anything better. Pipe guns are crude and somewhat unreliable, yet effective enough. Bolt-action models chamber heavier rifle rounds, trading rate of fire for power and simplicity.

Special: You cannot fit both a grip and a stock at the same time. Adding a stock changes the weapon type from a pistol to a rifle.
weapon_pipe_gun:
A crude, homemade weapon normally seen in the hands of those who cannot make, buy, or scavenge anything better. Pipe guns are rough and somewhat unreliable, yet effective enough. The most common model is a simple semi-auto pistol chambered for .38 rounds, though enterprising souls convert them for automatic fire or sniping.

Special: Adding a stock changes the weapon type from a pistol to a rifle.
weapon_pipe_revolver:
Like the other forms of pipe gun, the pipe revolver is a makeshift or homemade gun, in this case modelled after a revolver. It strikes a balance between the stopping power of the pipe bolt-action, and the fire rate of the pipe gun, and its improvised nature makes it similarly suited for modification.

Special: Adding a stock changes the weapon type from a pistol to a rifle.
weapon_railway_rifle: A makeshift weapon created by enterprising engineers in the wastelands, the railway rifle uses high-pressure steam to propel railway spikes at speeds sufficient to pierce and impale a wide range of targets.
weapon_syringer: A makeshift weapon using air pressure to propel customized syringes at a target. This inflicts little damage by itself, but the syringes can inflict a wide range of Debilitating effects.
weapon_357_magnum_revolver: A single-action revolver chambered for .357 magnum (though ones using .38 special rounds also exist). Not as potent as the feared and respected .44 revolver, these guns remain scattered around parts of the Wasteland due to their common use by police forces as service weapons and due to their extremely simple, durable build that makes them easy to maintain and extremely reliable.
weapon_12_7mm_pistol: A heavy-duty single-shot weapon with exceptional stopping power. Most known examples are believed to have been imported from overseas before the war. Given the weapon's punishing recoil, it can be tricky to use for those not prepared for its kick.
weapon_12_7mm_smg: An uncommon mixture of compact weapon and large-caliber round, the 12.7mm submachine gun features an unconventional top-mounted magazine, lying parallel to the weapon's barrel. While small and lightweight itself, the weapon's recoil and rate of fire can make it tricky to handle.
weapon_25mm_grenade_apw: The 25mm grenade APW is a semi-automatic grenade launcher. Specifically, this weapon contains a stock magazine capacity of six grenades, a brisk rate of fire, decent accuracy and allows modifications. While the grenades are much smaller and less impactful than those found in many other grenade launchers, the weapon itself is not as cumbersome as larger grenade launchers.
weapon_9mm_pistol: A common sight in the California and Mojave Wastelands and used as a standard sidearm by the New California Republic Army, this model of 9mm autoloader handgun was manufactured in vast quantities before the Great War. Its light weight, ease of handling, and common ammunition makes it a popular choice for personal defense, or as a backup weapon. However, the sturdy design doesn't lend itself as well to modifications as other common weapons.
weapon_anti_materiel_rifle: Utilizing an ergonomic, metallic skeleton design with a free-floating barrel, the anti-materiel rifle is a bolt-action, high-caliber precision weapon intended for use against materiel and hard targets. The weapon is designed for use at long ranges and should ideally not be fired while standing up due to the heavy recoil. Rare and highly sought-after, these guns are ideal for dealing with things like deathclaws, the larger radscorpions, and other sizeable threats… so long as you've got time to set up the first shot.
weapon_battle_rifle: Something of a relic of old 20th-century engineering, this sturdy, gas-operated semi-automatic rifle is nevertheless a solid choice of rifle for the discerning raider or mercenary. Its old-fashioned construction makes for a durable weapon with considerable stopping power, but it isn't easily modified.
weapon_black_powder_blunderbuss: An archaic percussion-cap firearm, of a kind possibly salvaged from museums or the collections of reenactors. They fire a heavy .50 musket ball propelled by gunpowder, and are only effective at very close ranges, but when they do hit, they can do a lot of damage.
weapon_black_powder_rifle: An archaic percussion-cap muzzle-loading rifle, of a kind possibly salvaged from museums or the collections of reenactors. The rifle's longer barrel gives it considerably longer range and slightly more stopping power than its smaller counterparts, but while it's fine against one or two foes, the slow rate of fire and long reload process make it inconvenient when heavily outnumbered.
weapon_black_powder_pistol: An archaic percussion-cap firearm, of a kind possibly salvaged from museums or the collections of reenactors. Compared to the blunderbuss, the pistol is less inaccurate and has a slightly longer effective range, but it packs no less of a punch.
weapon_gauss_shotgun: Technically more of a volley gun than a shotgun, as it fires multiple shots from multiple barrels at once, the gauss shotgun is a rare and devastating weapon which peppers a target with hypervelocity rounds.
weapon_lever_action_rifle: As the name suggests, a lever-action rifle uses a lever to cycle the weapon's action; this is typically part of the trigger guard, allowing the shooter to cycle the action with minimal effort or movement. Though this slows the rate of fire, it's a reliable design that stands up to use, time, and nuclear war.
weapon_light_machine_gun: The light machine gun is built to provide heavy firepower in a package not much larger than a typical rifle. While certainly heavier and more cumbersome than an assault rifle, it maintains a high rate of fire and can be easily modified with parts used by a variety of similar weapons, allowing the user to customize their fire support.
weapon_pump_action_shotgun: A solid and wide-spread design of shotgun found across the Wastelands. While it has a far larger magazine capacity than double-barreled shotguns, the slow (but distinctive) pump-action design keeps the rate of fire low compared to semi-automatic combat shotguns.
weapon_radium_rifle: The Radium Rifle irradiates bullets as they are fired, causing ballistic damage with an extra kick of radiation damage that is deadly to humans.
weapon_sniper_rifle: A scoped rifle once designed for use by military and police forces to eliminate targets efficiently from long distances. Its built-in optics and precision components make purpose-made sniper rifles harder to alter than standard hunting rifles.
weapon_m79_grenade_launcher: A grenade launcher is designed to launch large-caliber projectiles, generally with an explosive ordinance, although not always destructive in nature. M79 is not designed to shoot the ordinance at a specific target but to launch it at a general location giving the users options to focus on the ground.
weapon_pistol_injector: The first word in non-violent de-escalation - the Vault-Tec Pistol Injector is perfect for those who must intervene but do not want to resort to violence. For emergency use only.
weapon_ghoul_rifle: Taken from an unlucky trio of bounty hunters and subsequently upgraded by a Ghoul to unlock its full potential, this carbine combines range and rate of fire. Even so, it cannot match the Ghoul pistol and serves more as a backup should the pistol run out of ammunition.
weapon_ghoul_pistol: The Ghoul pistol is so heavily modified that its original form remains a mystery. Part revolver, part grenade launcher, this super-powerful pistol brings death and destruction both up close and at range. A truly terrifying weapon that is sure to leave a bloody mess at the pull of the trigger.
weapon_sten: A simple and inexpensive 9mm submachine gun, the Sten is easy to produce and widely used across the wasteland.
weapon_boarding_pistol:
This improvised boarding gun is fitted with metal barbs attached to an industrial cable and a miniature winch built into the frame. Once anchored in a solid surface, the winch pulls with enough force to reel a grown adult toward the anchor point. Some raiders and hunters also use boarding guns to snag prey.

* When a boarding pistol hits a target, the target must pass a STR + Athletics (character) or Body + Other (creature) test at difficulty 2. On a failure, you may spend a minor action to knock the target prone and pull them one zone closer to you. A snagged target may spend a minor action to break free. Additionally, boarding guns can be used to pull the wielder up to two zones at a speed of one zone per turn.
weapon_magnum_monicon:
The Magnum Monicon deals all types of damage. Apply damage as usual, then reduce it by the target's lowest damage resistance (Physical, Energy, Radiation, or Poison) at the point of impact.

Special: When attacks with this weapon reduce a creature or non-robot character to 0 HP, they die immediately and their corpse begins to mutate horrifically. If you spend 3 AP, the slain target rises on your next turn with half of its maximum HP and gains immunity to Radiation and Poison damage. The risen target acts immediately after you in the initiative order and obeys your commands. At the end of the current scene, it melts into a radioactive puddle, leaving behind a stomach-churning cloud of green vapor.
weapon_underwater_gun:
A pneumatic weapon developed for the US Navy. Its corrosion-resistant construction allows effective use underwater, firing specialized harpoons.

* Harpoons can be retrieved after firing.
weapon_chinese_assault_rifle: The Chinese assault rifle is a reliable and simple-to-maintain weapon, commonly found in the hands of raiders across the wasteland.
weapon_crossbow: Despite its primitiveness, the crossbow has many advantages: the weapon is light, ammunition is simpler to make than bullets, and shooting is nearly silent. Bolts can also be crafted with various effects, making it a versatile weapon.
weapon_bow: A simple recurve bow with a modest draw weight. Despite its primitive design, the bow offers many advantages: it is lightweight, its ammunition is easier to craft than bullets, and firing it is nearly silent. Arrows can also be tipped for different effects, making the bow a versatile weapon.
weapon_10mm_smg: A submachine gun chambered for 10mm rounds, capable of laying down rapid bursts of automatic fire.
weapon_fat_man: The M42 Nuclear Catapult is a shoulder-fired infantry support weapon which launches compact tactical nuclear warheads-mini-nukes, each about the size of a football-over a moderate distance to inflict massive destruction upon the target location.
weapon_flamer: A flamethrower, or flamer, is a weapon which sprays an ignited fuel mixture over an area, essentially creating a jet of flame that can burn or ignite targets at a distance. Ideal for clearing dead foliage, irritating vermin, and fortified bunkers!
weapon_gatling_laser: A high rate-of-fire laser weapon, the Gatling laser uses several rotating barrels fired in quick succession to produce a devastating fusillade of laser pulses. While the individual laser pulses lack in stopping power, the sheer mass of them can wear down almost any target. Gatling lasers can operate from any sufficient power source, and while fusion cells can be used to power them, the rate-of-fire means that they are often quickly expended. Most users instead rely on a larger power source, such as a fusion core.
weapon_heavy_incinerator: Like a flamethrower, a heavy incinerator also propels ignited fuel mixtures to burn a target. However, the heavy incinerator differs in that it appears to lob a succession of fireballs at the target, lobbing them in an arc like a grenade launcher. These fireballs burst upon impact, spreading flames as the fuel splashes off the target.
weapon_junk_jet:
The Junk Jet is a makeshift heavy weapon which fires anything. Any items loaded into the weapon's hopper are hurled with deadly force from the business end of the gun. Naturally, this makes it quite useful in situations where random junk is abundant but actual ammunition is scarce.

Special: When you fire the Junk Jet, choose any item you are currently carrying; that item is fired by the gun. Choose one additional item for each additional shot of ammunition spent by the attack. Items must be small enough to be held in one hand and loaded into the hopper. At the end of the scene, roll 1 CD for each item fired from the Junk Jet; on an Effect, that item survived the attack and can be reclaimed.
weapon_minigun: The minigun is a motorized Gatling-style rapid fire weapon commonly employed by the military, or other lesser factions that managed to acquire such a weapon. Miniguns can be found as mounted door guns on Vertibirds or as a handheld heavy assault and support weapon. The high rate-of-fire of the weapon means that it can produce devastating results, but at a cost of consuming ammo at incredible rates, making it difficult to keep the weapon supplied.
weapon_missile_launcher: A refined, highly adaptable multipurpose missile weapon introduced into the American arsenal, the modular launcher is smaller and more maneuverable than the earlier model. It consists of the two-part launch tube, firing mechanism, mounting brackets; open battle sights and a mount for a guidance system. It is a breech-loading weapon, reloaded by lifting the front section of the launch tube and sliding the 72mm fin-stabilized missile inside. The rear part of the tube is designed to safely disperse launch gasses, allowing it to be launched from confined spaces. Other forms and designs of Missile Launcher exist across the wastelands, but this form is common enough that most consider it the standard.
weapon_50_cal_machine_gun: These machine guns, chambered for the powerful .50 round, are extremely effective against infantry, materiel, lightly armored vehicles, boats, buildings, aircraft, and a wide range of other targets. This design has been in use in one form or another since long before the Great War but finds a new lease of life when carried by Power Armored fighters who can wield the cumbersome gun.
weapon_auto_grenade_launcher: The automatic grenade launcher (sometimes referred to as a grenade machine gun), is a belt-fed, blowback-operated, air-cooled automatic weapon designed to lay down a heavy volume of explosive ordnance and support infantry and vehicle operations. Designed for use as a crew-served weapon, the automatic grenade launcher was intended for use against a variety of targets ranging from infantry and light vehicles to fortifications and other materiel. The sheer weight of the weapon and bulk of the ammunition limited its versatility, until the advent of Power Armor. Since then, many units were converted for use on foot, rather than from a tripod.
weapon_broadsider: The broadsider is a naval cannon that has been modified with a chassis that allows for it to be a portable weapon. In addition to having a portable frame, the firing mechanism has been altered to include electronic triggers to avoid the traditional fuse. The cannon requires traditional loading however, with cannonballs being loaded directly into the muzzle.
weapon_gatling_gun: Originally referred to as "Gatling's battery gun", these weapons resemble an old-fashioned version of a minigun, with the rotating barrels operated by a hand-crank rather than an electric motor. Naturally, this means that it has a slower rate of fire than its more advanced counterpart, but the weapon is no less functional for its old-fashioned design.
weapon_gauss_minigun: The Gauss Minigun is a powerful, automatic ballistic weapon that rapidly fires hypervelocity 2mm rounds that deal devastating damage. Given their scarce ammunition and the sheer rate of fire it possesses—particularly when modified—this is a powerful weapon that demands a wealthy and well-supplied owner. It can even be fitted with a Tesla coil, charging rounds with electricity as they're fired.
weapon_cryolator: The cryolator, a machine designed with the ability to perform cryogenic freezing while maintaining mobility. Operating on a similar principle to a flamer, the cryolater takes pressurized nitrogen gas from a cryo cell and liquefies it, spraying the concentrated chemical element over a desired area in range.
weapon_tesla_cannon: The Tesla cannon is a shoulder-mounted directed energy weapon using technology based on designs by Nikola Tesla. The weapon entered limited production pre-War, and is a rare sight in the Wastelands, but some branches of the Brotherhood of Steel have sought out the technology and attempted to recreate it for their own needs.
weapon_drone_cannon: Found on the arms of guardian drones—a form of alien robot sometimes seen on board crashed alien spacecraft—these potent, if strange, energy weapons fire a ball of energy that acts a little like a grenade, bouncing for a few seconds before exploding.
weapon_harpoon_gun: The harpoon gun is a handheld version of the harpoon cannon, sacrificing power for mobility. A special designed chassis allows for the weapon to be portable and is adapted with a firing mechanism for convenient firing.
weapon_tear_gas_launcher: Tear gas is a mixture of various aerosol irritants and compounds, ideally suited for repelling or incapacitating crowds or large animals. Tear gas is also effective for flushing unsuspecting enemies out of entrenched positions.
weapon_eugene: A heavily modified minigun, this impressive 'vacuum cleaner' is the pride and joy of Brick, an eager heavy-weapons specialist from Reilly's Rangers. Fine-tuned and ready for anything, it is perhaps one of the most lethal and flawlessly tuned killing machines in the Capital Wasteland.
weapon_plasma_caster:
Old industrial plasma casters survived the Great War even as more compact plasma rifles eventually appeared. The plasma caster hits harder and fires faster than standard plasma guns, though it is heavy, inaccurate, and kicks with formidable recoil.

Special: Plasma weapons inflict both Physical and Energy damage. Roll damage as normal, then reduce the total by whichever of the target's damage resistances is lower out of Physical or Energy. Any Persistent damage effects inflicted by weapon mods deal Energy damage.
weapon_sten_injector: For those times when a single dart is not enough, this tranquilizer submachine gun can turn several enemies at once into truly... exceptionally calm pincushions. Side effects may vary. Vault-Tec is not responsible for loss of taste, touch, motor functions, or death caused by an overdose of tranquilizer.
weapon_gatling_plasma:
An evolution of plasma gun technology, the gatling plasma is a rare, potent, and costly weapon to use. Like smaller weapons of its kind, it inflicts damage through a combination of both physical impact and thermal transfer, and like other gatling weaponry, it inflicts this damage via a rapid-firing collection of rotating barrels that spray huge numbers of shots at the enemy. The relative scarcity of plasma cartridges, or extremely rare plasma cores, and the rate at which this weapon consumes ammunition, means that keeping the weapon supplied for use can be a full-time job.

Special: Plasma weapons inflict both Physical and Energy damage. Roll damage as normal, then reduce the total by whichever of the target's damage resistances is lower out of Physical or Energy. Any Persistent damage effects inflicted by weapon mods deal Energy damage.
weapon_laser_musket:
The laser musket is a homemade form of laser rifle, blending advanced technology with strangely primitive mechanisms, popular with militia groups such as the Minutemen. The laser musket must be manually primed, charging the makeshift capacitor through turning a hand-crank on the weapon's rear. While seemingly crude, they can make for potent sniper's weapons, especially with a modified capacitor able to hold a larger charge.

Special: Firing a laser musket consumes two shots of ammunition each time it is fired. Each capacitor mod increases both damage and the number of shots consumed. You may reduce the number of shots consumed, reducing the damage by 1 CD for each shot consumed fewer than normal (to a minimum of 4 CD damage and 1 shot consumed).
weapon_laser_gun: Laser guns are high-tech weapons which emit a concentrated beam of coherent, directional light, intense enough to inflict serious damage. They were a relatively new development in the years before the Great War, and thus are not an especially common sight in the wasteland, outside of those groups who've secured old military weapons caches. Most surviving models of laser gun-such as the dependable AER9, widely used by the U. S. Army-use an internal capacitor charged by a microfusion power cell.
weapon_plasma_gun:
Plasma guns, or plasma casters, are high-tech weapons firing super heated ionized gas, or plasma. Powered by a plasma cartridge, these weapons are rare and potent, delivering damage through the high-speed impact of the plasma bolt and then thermal transfer as the heat from the plasma bolt is transferred into the target at the moment of impact.

Special: Plasma guns inflict both Physical and Energy damage. Roll damage as normal, then reduce the total by whichever of the target's damage resistances is lower out of Physical or Energy. Any Persistent damage effects (applied by weapon mods) inflict Energy damage.
weapon_gamma_gun: A crude-looking weapon, the gamma gun emits directed blasts of high-intensity ionizing radiation which can be devastating to any creature not immune nor massively resistant to radiation, while leaving other targets largely unharmed.
weapon_mesmetron: A weapon similar to the gamma gun with the ability to create blasts of high intense energy. This approach creates variable waves that, when received by the brain of a sentient creature, overwhelms the senses and distorts perception making individuals confused and more susceptible.
weapon_wattz_2000: Created to eliminate enemies from a distance, the Wattz 2000 laser rifle combines accuracy and range in a purpose-built long-range energy weapon.
weapon_tesla_rifle: The Tesla gun is a firearm that takes the energy from a fusion cell and launches the energy out as a coil of electrical energy. The energy generally seeks out a way to dissipate allowing for it to arc out to multiple targets in a single shot.
weapon_acid_soaker: The acid soaker is a small gun, similar to the 10mm pistol, that has been modified to receive the corrosive compound of an acid concentrate instead of the traditional ballistic chamber. The modifications match the design components of a common squirt gun designed to shoot jets of water.
weapon_alien_atomizer: A form of alien energy pistol, found in use by the extra-terrestrial beings sometimes called "Zetans". Encounters with these creatures are extremely rare, and their weapons are extremely potent. Nobody understands their technology well enough to modify these guns, however.
weapon_alien_disintegrator: A form of alien energy rifle, appearing like a space-age blunderbuss, found in use by the extra-terrestrial beings sometimes called "Zetans". Like the smaller atomizers, the technology of these weapons is too unknown for anyone to successfully modify one of these weapons.
weapon_alien_blaster:
The alien blaster is sometimes referred to as an alien blaster pistol based on its physical appearance mimicking the small firearms designed on Earth. Meant to be held in one hand where the index or middle finger could fit around the trigger, this weapon is capable of using the unique alien energy like a laser gun uses fusion cells.

Special: Alien blasters inflict both Energy and Radiation damage. Any creature killed by an alien blaster is vaporized and reduced to ash.
weapon_microwave_emitter: This advanced energy weapon generates intense blasts of microwave radiation. While it won't irradiate you—microwaves are non-ionizing radiation—it can cause intense burns as whatever is hit by the blast is heated up from the inside, boiling the water in your cells. And metal is little protection: the microwave blast can't effectively be dispersed by metallic objects, which heat up, produce electrical sparks, damage delicate circuitry. While extremely rare, these weapons provide a serious advantage when used against heavily armored targets.
weapon_arc_welder: This odd weapon can discharge a constant, high-voltage stream of electricity. While painful and damaging to living creatures, it is especially effective against robots and enemies in Power Armor, as electricity discharges into delicate components.
weapon_assaultron_head_laser:
The head of an Assaultron contains a high-yield laser emitter, shielded behind sturdy armor plating. Assaultrons use this laser to blast the enemy as they close into melee. The laser itself uses a capacitor that can build up an extremely powerful charge, but which requires considerable energy for each fully charged blast. Due to the solid design, destroyed Assaultrons sometimes have an intact head that can be used as an impromptu hand-held laser.

Special: Firing an Assaultron head laser consumes two charges of ammunition each time it is fired. Each capacitor mod increases both damage and the number of charges consumed. You may reduce the number of charges consumed, reducing damage by 1 CD for each charge fewer than normal (to a minimum of 4 CD damage and 1 charge consumed).
weapon_institute_laser: Developed by The Institute after the Great War, Institute lasers differ in design and function from the pre-War lasers used by other factions such as the Brotherhood of Steel. Eschewing raw power for a rapid succession of beams, these lasers can lay down a searing volley of suppressive fire.
weapon_sword: Swords have been in use for almost as long as wars have been fought and remained widespread as symbols of status and prestige amongst soldiers-particularly officers across the world right up until the Great War. Many of the swords found in the wastelands are those used by Chinese officers during the Great War, often taken from battlefields as a trophy by American troops. Others are museum pieces or replicas from private collections, with many resembling the cavalry sabers used during the American Revolution.
weapon_combat_knife: For both fighting and for utility uses, soldiers-and those who seek to emulate soldiers-frequently carry knives. The Combat Knife found across the wastelands is normally of the same type as was issued to U.S. Army soldiers during the Great War, a single-edged blade with a clipped point. The weapon is lightweight and sturdy, and intended for heavy use.
weapon_machete: A long, sharp knife designed to hack through dense or tough vegetation, the same properties that make it a useful tool also make it an effective weapon. While some machetes found in the wasteland were purpose-made blades, others are makeshift tools, typically made from a sharpened metal blade such as that salvaged from a lawnmower, bolted, tied, taped, or otherwise affixed to a simple handle.
weapon_ripper: The Ripper is a small, handheld, militarised chainsaw that saw extensive use in the armed conflicts before the Great War, with a commercial-grade, scaled-down version made available for the general market. It can saw through both flesh and metal alike with ease.
weapon_switchblade: The switchblade is a commonly found melee weapon. Its small size means that it is easily smuggled into restricted areas and is easy to handle. It doesn't do as damage as larger knives or blades, however.
weapon_shishkebab: A makeshift "flaming sword," the Shishkebab appears in various forms across the wastelands—some built around real swords, others cobbled from scrap. All share the same essentials: a fuel tank or canister (attached or worn with a hose), a pilot light, and an ignition trigger.
weapon_auto_axe: Reminiscent of a larger, more devastating Ripper, an Auto-Axe is a motorized saw assembled with automotive engine parts, replacing the chain with four rotating axe blades spinning around a central spindle.
weapon_baseball_bat_aluminum: Baseball bats were once used in the sport of baseball, considered America's number-one pastime during the pre-War era. Two hundred years later, they have been re-purposed as crude but effective melee weapons. While most are made of a single piece of wood-normally ash, but other hardwoods are often used a few can be found made of aluminum instead, making for a lighter, harder bat.
weapon_tire_iron: A simple L-shaped tool found commonly in cars and garages; tire irons make for handy weapons when not being used to change the tires on a car.
weapon_baseball_bat: Baseball bats were once used in the sport of baseball, considered America's number-one pastime during the pre-War era. Two hundred years later, they have been re-purposed as crude but effective melee weapons, typically carved from solid ash or other sturdy hardwoods.
weapon_chainsaw:
A two-handed motorized saw that chews through flesh and armour, ignoring the wielder's normal melee damage bonus.

Special: A Chainsaw does not benefit from the wielder's normal melee damage bonus.
weapon_pool_cue: A long, slender piece of wood used in games like pool. Useful as a melee weapon if there's nothing to hand with more heft.
weapon_bumper_sword: A sword welded from a car bumper — heavy and crude, but effective.
weapon_war_drum:
A heavy two-handed drum weapon; its booming sound raises the complication range on sneak attacks.

Special: When used to make a sneak attack, a War Drum increases the complication range by 1 due to the sound it makes.
weapon_guitar_sword:
A reviled instrument used as a bladed weapon; its twang raises the complication range on sneak attacks.

Special: When used to make a sneak attack, a Guitar Sword increases the complication range by 1 due to the sound it makes.
weapon_board: Little more than a long plank of wood with a handle wrapped in duct tape. Boards are heavy melee weapons, normally favored by super mutants who have the strength to wield them effectively.
weapon_baton: A collapsible baton of the sort used by police departments and private security forces before the Great War. Vault-Tec security within each vault had a stock of these, so they remain in common use as a lightweight back-up melee weapon.
weapon_assaultron_blade: A mechanical blade fitted to an Assaultron robot's chassis, capable of delivering a piercing blow.
weapon_sledgehammer: Sledgehammers are primitive weapons, used as tools before the Great War, for breaking ground or demolishing things. Although not usually considered as a powerful weapon, a strong person-or a super mutant-can wield one of these like a club, taking full advantage of the hammer's weight.
weapon_atom_staff: A reinforced metal staff roughly five feet long topped with the symbol of Atom set in a golden disc. Kinetic capacitors along the shaft amplify the force of every blow, while its length lets the wielder parry incoming melee strikes.
weapon_proton_axe: An energy weapon that releases a surge of ionizing energy on impact, piercing armour.
weapon_pipe_wrench: A heavy, metal, adjustable wrench, long enough to be used as a makeshift melee weapon. The adjustable jaws are often used to hold attachments, allowing the wrench to be modded extremely easily.
weapon_lead_pipe: A length of heavy, metal (normally lead) pipe, with a duct-tape wrapped grip at one end and a few nuts and bolts attached at the other. Crude, simple, and hurts like hell.
weapon_rolling_pin: A sturdy cylinder of wood found in kitchens everywhere. Heavy enough to deter an assortment of attackers if you haven't got something more dangerous.
weapon_super_sledge: Super Sledgehammers are powered variants of the regular sledgehammer. Older, pre-War designs were outfitted with kinetic storage devices to increase the impact force, while post-War ones mount a small rocket motor within the hammer's head to accelerate the swing and deliver a heavier blow.
weapon_death_tambo:
A bladed tambourine weapon; the jingling it makes raises the complication range on sneak attacks.

Special: When used to make a sneak attack, a Death Tambo increases the complication range by 1 due to the jingling sound it makes.
weapon_walking_cane: A simple stick used to support those who can't walk so well, a walking cane is sturdy enough to be an impromptu weapon if you've not got any other options.
weapon_multi_purpose_axe: A practical two-handed axe able to double as a cutting implement.
weapon_mr_handy_buzz_blade: A two-handed rotary blade attachment for a Mr Handy robot, driven by a buzz-saw mechanism.
weapon_mining_drill:
Originally built to bore through solid rock and place blasting charges rather than for combat, a mining drill is cumbersome yet tears cleanly through armor.

Special: An integrated fusion cell housing can drive higher rotational speeds. During an attack, the user may spend 1 to 3 charges from a fusion cell to add an equal number of CD to the base damage.
weapon_cattle_prod: A two-handed rod delivering a powerful electric stun to its target.
unarmed_human: Sometimes your fists are the only weapon you have.
weapon_ballistic_fist:
A heavy fist-mounted weapon that fires a shotgun shell with each punch; must be reloaded between attacks.

Special: This weapon requires ammunition, expending one shotgun shell with each attack. Due to the Slow Load quality, it must be reloaded as a minor action before it can be used again; without a shotgun shell, a ballistic fist simply makes a normal unarmed attack.
weapon_boxing_glove: A large, leather mitt, used to protect the hands and wrists while punching. While originally used during sporting matches, a skilled fighter can use these to deliver solid blows to enemies in less organized fights, particularly if they've modified the glove in some way.
weapon_knuckles: Developed in antiquity, brass knuckles remain quite prevalent across the post-War wastelands. Four linked metal rings wrap over the user's fingers with a solid bar braced against the palm, concentrating the force of every punch.
weapon_deathclaw_gauntlet: Made from the severed fingers and talons of a deathclaw and mounted on a cuff which fits over the wrist, these allow the wearer to strike with some of the lethal force of the claws' previous owner.
weapon_displacer_glove: A heavy gauntlet that delivers piercing and stunning damage in melee.
weapon_power_fist: A Power Fist is a reinforced gauntlet or vambrace which mounts a heavy-duty pneumatic ram over the knuckles. Designed for use by demolition crews, it has also seen military use for breaching fortifications and clearing enemy barricades... and enemies.
weapon_rock: A simple rock. Primitive, but effective when thrown with enough force.
weapon_javelin: A short spear, not typically sturdy enough for close-in fighting, a javelin can be thrown a considerable distance.
weapon_throwing_knife: A small, sharp knife, specially balanced for throwing. Normally made of a lightweight metal, with the grip hollowed out to reduce weight. They do little damage by themselves, but are light, quiet, and quick to handle.
weapon_tomahawk: A small, short-handled axe, akin to a small hatchet. Less subtle than a throwing knife, a hurled tomahawk can certainly make an impression in an enemy.
weapon_pulse_mine:
A proximity-triggered mine that emits a burst of electromagnetism, devastating to machines.

Special: Pulse mines only inflict damage upon robots, synths, Power Armor (though not the wearer inside), and other technological targets including computers and electronics. Against all other targets they inflict 0 damage.
weapon_baseball_grenade: Little more than a hollowed-out baseball filled with an improvised explosive mixture, these grenades are crude, low-tech, and easy to make, dealing a moderate amount of damage to those within the blast.
weapon_detonator:
A remote detonator used to trigger placed explosives from a distance as a minor action.

Special: When a Placed explosive is being set, if you have a Detonator, you may choose to wire the explosive to trigger remotely. This removes the Delay (X) quality and lets you detonate the explosive as a minor action at any point during the scene while within Long range. Multiple explosives may be linked to one detonator, increasing the PER + Explosives test difficulty by +1 for each additional bomb. When triggered, all linked explosives detonate simultaneously.
weapon_dynamite:
A stick of dynamite with a lit fuse, thrown and set to detonate on impact.

Special: Single sticks of dynamite are assumed to have a short fuse that detonates on the same turn they are lit and thrown, functioning like a normal grenade. A character may prepare longer fuses with a PER + Explosives test at difficulty 1 (preparing one stick on a success, plus one additional stick per AP spent); long-fuse dynamite gains the Delay (X) quality with a rating chosen when prepared.
weapon_smoke_grenade:
A thrown grenade that produces a thick cloud of smoke, blocking sight and imposing +2 difficulty to tests.

Special: When a smoke grenade detonates, it generates a cloud of smoke filling the affected zone. Characters cannot see while inside the cloud, nor into or through it from outside, adding +2 difficulty to all attacks and PER-based tests made by or against anyone within the cloud. At the end of each round roll 1 CD plus +1 CD for each round the cloud has persisted; if one or more Effects are rolled, the smoke disperses.
weapon_pulse_grenade:
Pulse grenades emit a burst of electromagnetism which inflicts massive damage to machines-such as robots, synths, and Power Armor-within the vicinity, while leaving living creatures unharmed.

Special: Pulse grenades only inflict damage upon robots, synths, Power Armor (though not the wearer inside), and other technological targets including computers and electronics. Against all other targets they inflict 0 damage.
weapon_molotov: Consisting of a glass bottle-normally from an alcoholic beverage—containing a flammable fuel mixture, a bit of motor oil to help it spread, and an alcohol-soaked rag stuffed in the top to act as a wick. When used, the wick is ignited and the bottle hurled at the target; the breaking bottle spreads the agitated mixture, which quickly ignites and begins to burn anything in the vicinity. Cheap and effective.
weapon_cryo_mine: A placed mine that freezes the area around it in a blast of cryogenic energy.
weapon_cryogenic_grenade: A thrown grenade that freezes affected targets in a cryogenic blast.
weapon_bottlecap_mine:
The Bottlecap mine is crudely put together, yet a formidable explosive. Bottlecap mines are constructed from a simple container such as a lunchbox, filled with bottle caps and a crude explosive mixture, and fitted with a sensor and a detonator. The explosive force hurls the caps over a wide area at such speed that they are essentially shrapnel.

Special: When crafting a bottlecap mine, extra bottlecaps may be added: every 10 extra bottlecaps increase damage by +1 CD. After detonation, re-roll the weapon's damage dice to determine how many intact bottlecaps can be salvaged in the blast zone.
weapon_frag_grenade: A basic fragmentation grenade, consisting of an explosive core within a metal casing designed to shatter into shrapnel upon detonation. They're simple and highly effective. Just remember to throw the grenade, and not the pin.
weapon_frag_grenade_mirv: A multiple-ploy grenade that scatters several explosive submunitions over the blast area.
weapon_frag_mine: Similar in design and construction to a frag grenade, a fragmentation mine is instead placed on the ground and uses a pressure plate or proximity sensor to trigger detonation when someone gets too close.
weapon_plasma_grenade:
A canister containing chemicals which are rapidly transformed into superheated ionized gas-or plasma-upon detonation. The blast of a plasma grenade generates vast amounts of heat which more than makes up for the lack of shrapnel or concussive shockwaves.

Special: Plasma grenades inflict both Physical and Energy damage. Roll damage as normal, then reduce the total by whichever of the target's damage resistances is lower out of Physical or Energy.
weapon_plasma_mine:
These magnetically sealed mines unleash a blast of energized plasma upon being triggered, searing those who tripped the mine's sensors.

Special: Plasma mines inflict both Physical and Energy damage. Roll damage as normal, then reduce the total by whichever of the target's damage resistances is lower out of Physical or Energy.
weapon_plastic_explosives:
Malleable explosive placed on a surface, detonated remotely or by delay; the Delay rating is set when placed.

Special: The rating of the Delay (X) quality is chosen when the bomb is placed.
weapon_powder_charge:
A small explosive charge; may be used as a mine or converted to a delayed placed device.

Special: A Powder Charge may replace its Mine quality with the Delay (X) and Placed qualities, requiring a few minutes of work and a PER + Explosives test at difficulty 1. The Delay rating is chosen when the bomb is placed.
weapon_flash_bang:
A thrown stun grenade that blinds and stuns those caught in its blast.

Special: On a hit, every creature caught within the blast of a Flash Bang is stunned as per the Stun damage effect. If the attack misses, there is no effect.
weapon_dynamite_bundle:
A bundle of dynamite sticks rigged to detonate with a delay; the Delay rating is set when placed.

Special: Dynamite bundles have the Delay (X) quality with a rating chosen when the bomb is placed. Single sticks may also be thrown with a short fuse (detonating that turn), or prepared with longer Delay (X) fuses via a PER + Explosives test at difficulty 1 (+1 stick per AP spent).
weapon_nuka_grenade: A tiny, handheld tactical nuclear weapon, a Nuka grenade is extremely dangerous to use-dropping one is ill-advised-but devastatingly effective, comparable to the mini-nukes used by the Fat Man launcher.
weapon_nuke_mine: It is a nuclear variant of a landmine. The Nuke mine operates in all respects as other mines do although its explosion is more akin to that of a mini-nuke. Naturally, this means that they inflict damage from both the explosion and from the radiation the blast emits.
